comment: Provenance overlay for the DEV fixture catalog (never used in production
builds): the vite dev server serves catalog-release.json plus per-family
zips built from host font files (gui/scripts/dev-catalog.mjs), so a plain
`npm run dev` boots a working catalog without touching the ~375 MB real
release. Font binaries never enter git; this file only carries the honest
metadata those host files would show in a picker row.
